criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 4 and 9 come close to the showstopper test, with toy-like paws and coat at native size. 5 a primitive monitor on an unbuilt wall with a banded clip and 23px rows; 6 reads as an embossed tile grid with no visible long cast and corner chips; 8 a textured rectangle on a bar with a dead lower third; 3 a small dog in a grey-middle band with labels on plates; 2 a slab phone from the screen side; 7 a chart card on a bordered slab.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, the box changes state, the dog a spine, the cut at 6 declared; frame 5's cold room and 6 to 8's clay sit outside the palette, 6 and 7 two grids, frame 3's declared sight lines gone.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every claim id resolves to a primary release, quotes verbatim, numerals traced, the 2019 finding refused aloud; slide 3's 'on each clip' a shade looser than c4 and c5.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, where, how and when named; the appearance stake on 4 never says what the label does; no next step or venue.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, turns at 4 and 6; 6 and 7 restate, 8 and 9 both end on the final report.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: House rules held; leans on 'The release says'; no place texture in the type; flat hook on 9; the caption's closing question the best line.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject and a new POV opening; the lastLight register and a caliche relief run again.

ranked_defects.defect: Primitive monitor on a blank wall, banded clip, cropped keyboard, 23px rows.
ranked_defects.fix: Wall to black, monitor turned 30 degrees, the real slide 1 render on the screen, rows at 24px or more.

ranked_defects.defect: Embossed tile grid, no visible long cast, corner chip artifacts.
ranked_defects.fix: Triple plug height, key at about 12 degrees, irregular street plan.

ranked_defects.defect: Labels and footer on plates; small dog; grey-middle band.
ranked_defects.fix: Camera in until the dog is a third of the frame height; labels on darkness.

ranked_defects.defect: Slab phone from the screen side, no lens discs, blocky clamp.
ranked_defects.fix: Three-quarter rear view with the lens island and a modelled jaw.

ranked_defects.defect: Flat block on a bar, empty lower third.
ranked_defects.fix: Rule at mid frame, block half the frame height.

ranked_defects.defect: Bordered chart card back to back with 6.
ranked_defects.fix: Bleed the slab off both edges; fold 6 in.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: UI mock on an unbuilt wall.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Screen-only light, monitor turned, real render on the screen.
Closer camera, background to near black, no plates.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Boxy phone slab, no lens discs.
